summary.text: Brandon Sabbag is the Republican and Independent Party of Connecticut candidate for Connecticut House of Representatives District 139 in the November 3, 2026 general election, against incumbent Larry Pemberton (D).
Sabbag was also the Republican candidate in the January 13, 2026 special general election for the seat, which Pemberton won with 64.5 percent of the vote to Sabbag's 28.5 percent.
